findings.location: content.body.scope.noteUk: "Додатковий крок, щоб значення poder не поширювалося на навички."
findings.description: This categorically excludes skills from the meaning of poder. Poder can express a person's capacity to perform an activity; the distinction from saber is not an absolute prohibition.
findings.suggestion: Explain that saber explicitly expresses learned know-how, while poder expresses ability or possibility. Use sufficiently explicit contexts when assessing the distinction.

items.reviewerAnswer: Saber + infinitive expresses learned know-how: Sé nadar. Poder can also express ability.
items.notes: The construction, examples and main rule are otherwise correct.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entries «poder» and «saber», ability-related senses (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: "No ___ conducir: no tengo coche."; task.options[1] marks "sé" incorrect.
findings.description: The sentence does not establish whether the speaker knows how to drive. Car ownership can explain either a current practical limitation or why the speaker has never learned. The feedback assumes the first reading.
findings.suggestion: Establish explicitly that the speaker knows how to drive but currently lacks access to a car, or allow both readings.

items.reviewerAnswer: a (puedo) is the likely intended answer; b (sé) also fits if not owning a car explains never learning to drive.
items.notes: The missing information is the speaker's driving competence and the intended causal relationship.
sources: Course contract rule 2 and the supplied definition of the verdict "uncertain".
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entries «poder» and «saber», ability-related senses (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: "Mi hija tiene tres años y no ___ leer."; task.options[1] marks "puede" incorrect.
findings.description: Age alone does not uniquely select saber. No sabe leer describes missing learned know-how; no puede leer can describe lack of reading capacity. Poder is not grammatically excluded merely because reading is learned.
findings.suggestion: Specify that the learner must express "does not know how to read", or accept both interpretations with differentiated explanations.

items.reviewerAnswer: a (sabe) is the expected know-how reading; b (puede) can express the child's inability to read.
items.notes: The intended distinction between know-how and capacity is missing.
sources: Course contract rule 2 and the supplied definition of the verdict "uncertain".
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entries «poder» and «saber», ability-related senses (from memory).

findings.location: task.hints[1].blocks[0].text: "У готелі нам треба звільнити номер до дванадцятої."

findings.suggestion: Use "У готелі нам треба вийти з номера о дванадцятій." If a checkout deadline is intended, revise the Spanish accordingly.

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: "¡Hola, Ana! El sábado no puedo ir a la playa: ___ trabajar."; task.options[1] marks "quiero" incorrect.
findings.description: Declining a beach invitation because of work does not establish an obligation. The speaker may be prioritizing work they want to do. The feedback supplies an obligation that the prompt does not state.
findings.suggestion: Specify in Ukrainian that work is an obligation, add context establishing it, or accept the desire reading as well.

items.reviewerAnswer: a (tengo que) or b (quiero), depending on whether work is an obligation or a personal priority.
items.notes: Option a is the most conventional intended completion, but the prompt does not uniquely establish it.
sources: Course contract rule 2 and the supplied definition of the verdict "uncertain".
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entries «querer» and «tener», including tener que + infinitive (from memory).

findings.location: content.body.blocks[1].text: "Змінюється лише перше дієслово; прийменник (que, de, a) — частина конструкції, після poder і saber його немає."
findings.description: The parenthesis classifies que as a preposition. Que in tener que + infinitive is a linking element, not a preposition. This misuses the Ukrainian grammatical term "прийменник".
findings.suggestion: Use "Змінюється лише перше дієслово. Елементи que, de та a — частина відповідних конструкцій; після poder і saber інфінітив іде без прийменника."

items.reviewerAnswer: The frames and examples are correct. De and a are prepositions; que in tener que must not be labelled a preposition.
sources: Course contract rule 8.
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, «tener(se)», discussion of tener que + infinitive (from memory).
Словник української мови, entry «прийменник» (from memory).
